authority_ceiling: read-only observation below PromotionLedger.evaluate, merge, release, deployment, host, system, developer and user authority
purpose: Bind one persisted rehydration loop to an explicit Git-head promotion observation without allowing the loop to mint qualification.
outputs: exact-head persisted PROMRUNs and deterministic replay standing

exact_head_law.LOOP_CHECKPOINT: commit that last wrote loop state.json

compatibility.rehydration_control_v1_1: optional; cycle_gate is observed from frozen receipt if present
compatibility.rehydration_successor_v1: optional; successor baton is observed from frozen receipt if present
compatibility.github_promotion_verifier_1: optional host observation; unavailable verifier remains non-authoritative

invariants: observer contains no PromotionLedger.evaluate call path
GitHub check verification alone never produces PERSISTED_QUALIFIED_OBSERVED
only exact target-head PROMRUNs are considered
every persisted run is replayed before contributing to standing
replay verifies frozen predicate determinism and is not external provider reverification
cycle-local VERIFIED_CYCLE never upgrades promotion authority
